pool.tagline: Today's stars only. No legends, no reserves.
pool.description: A curated 2026-27 season database, built for recognizability rather than raw coverage. Every name here is someone a football fan would actually know - active professionals only, no legends and no anonymous squad fillers.

_instructions.whatIsThis: The 2026-27 season 'Current Players' pool - active professionals only, curated for recognizability rather than exhaustive coverage. See pools/index.json for how pools work in general.
_instructions.howToUpdate: Each summer transfer window: re-verify every player's current club (do not trust memory - a full window closes every year), refresh ages, and keep the recognizability bar. Quality over quantity was the whole point of this pool.
